episodeTitle.en: Lessons from scaling Uber and Opendoor | Brian Tolkin (Head of Product at Opendoor, ex-Uber)
episodeTitle.zh: Uber和Opendoor扩张的经验教训 | Brian Tolkin（Opendoor产品主管，前Uber员工）

guestBioOfficial.en: Brian Tolkin is the Head of Product at Opendoor. Previously, he was one of the early employees at Uber, where he was instrumental in launching and growing UberPool, UberHop, and UberExpress and started one of the first product operations teams in tech. In our conversation, we dive into: • How to enable product and ops to work well together
guestBioOfficial.zh: Brian Tolkin是Opendoor的产品主管。此前，他是Uber的早期员工之一，在那里他在推出和发展UberPool、UberHop和UberExpress方面发挥了重要作用，并在科技领域创立了首批产品运营团队之一。在对话中，我们深入探讨了：• 如何让产品和运营部门协同高效工作

title.en: Lessons from scaling Uber and Opendoor | Brian Tolkin (Head of Product at Opendoor, ex-Uber)
title.zh: Uber和Opendoor扩张的经验教训 | Brian Tolkin（Opendoor产品主管，前Uber员工）

summary.en: Brian shares lessons on building products with a heavy operational component, arguing that ops experience gives a deep understanding of how the business actually works. He covers how to run great product reviews, how Opendoor applies the Jobs-to-be-Done framework, and the story of Zillow competing with then partnering Opendoor. The conversation is full of stories from the early days of Uber and Opendoor on scaling operationally-heavy tech companies.
summary.zh: Brian 分享了打造“强运营属性”产品的经验，认为运营经历让人深刻理解业务实际如何运转。他讲述了如何做好产品评审、Opendoor 如何应用“待办任务”框架，以及 Zillow 先竞争后合作的故事。对话充满了 Uber 与 Opendoor 早期扩展“重运营”科技公司的故事。
